subject.title: [Feature]: `announceTarget` option for sub-agent completion announce routing

question: Should OpenClaw accept `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"` as a public native `sessions_spawn` and `agents.*.subagents` contract?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix adds durable model-facing and config semantics in a message-delivery/session-state path where repository policy requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept opt-in parent routing
options.body: Review and land the linked PR or an equivalent after the resolver/proof gaps are addressed, keeping current channel delivery as the default.

options.title: Per-spawn only first
options.body: Accept only the model-facing per-call option now and defer global/per-agent config defaults until upgrade and operator-policy implications are clearer.

options.title: Keep workaround-only behavior
options.body: Close or pause the implementation path and leave parent handoff to explicit `sessions_send` patterns until a broader orchestration contract is chosen.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in parent routing
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR or an equivalent after the resolver/proof gaps are addressed, keeping current channel delivery as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the tool, owns much of the spawn/announce history, and already described the focused implementation shape on this issue.
